_note: Cost-model parameters per model for terminus-2 (units: tokens). L0 = part of the post-compaction prompt that is still a cache hit, Lp = part written anew (L0 + Lp = prompt right after compaction), g = prompt growth per turn (median), m = full-context reads by the summarization calls, gamma = price multiplier of those reads relative to a cache read, summary_out = their output tokens, phi = Lp slope in L. Entries written by analysis/fit_priors.py; the qwen27b ones are older local vLLM measurements.

terminus2-qwen27b-think._detail: Lp = fixed 0.9K + summary 2.7K + screen 0.6K + questions 0.9K + answers 2.4K; summary and answers calls both read the full context (m=2), the questions call reads ~3K only; summary_out = 2712+883+2384. Locally the cache was mostly cold after compaction (gamma may be ~alpha).
